text:
sam: ACME asked for a certified marketplace image that pins driver combos (ROCm + compatible CUDA fallback). They hit regressions on ROCm 5.3 and want an expedited pinned release.

dina: We can push a hotfix seed: drivers/marketplace/rocm-5.2.3. Need to confirm kernel variants and produce signed package hashes.

vijay: Suggest building two AMIs (k5.15 & k6.1) and a container tarball for SI installs. Also include manifest with sha256s for each package.

sam: Can we automate fallback? If small-batch throughput on A100 regresses on ROCm, runtime should route to CUDA variant automatically.

dina: Runtime supports variant routing. I'll add a marketplace rule: "match: hw==A100 && perf_signal.rocmsmallbatch==true -> route: cuda-compat". I'll open PR to marketplace-routing.

ops-bot: pipeline triggered: `hotfix/marketplace-rocm-5.2.3` -> artifact `mkt-art-2026-03-23-04`

vijay: QA smoke: median latency +1.2%, p95 stable, small-batch throughput -5% on A100. Filing ticket INF-7680 with logs.

sam: Action items: 1) dina cut AMIs + manifest, 2) vijay produce offline bundle + perf logs, 3) partnerships coordinate signing window with ACME (I will), 4) ops add routing rule to canary lane.

dina: Starting AMI build now. Tagging: `redwood-runtime:rocm-5.2.3-20260323`. Will upload manifest to artifacts.

vijay: Uploaded perf artifacts: https://internal.redwood/attachments/rocm-5.2.3-smoke.zip

acme-infra-bot: ACME notified: signing request queued.

sam: Please react with :thumbsup: when your task is complete.

dina: :thumbsup: (AMIs + manifest uploaded)

vijay: :thumbsup: (bundle + logs)

sam: Thanks — will request ACME start signing tomorrow morning and coordinate canary. Leave thread open for regressions.
